name: Kamal Hossain
role: Chair of the Constitution Drafting Committee
contribution: He chaired the committee that drafted the 1972 Constitution and became one of the principal legal architects of Bangladesh's original parliamentary framework.
context: State formation and constitutional drafting in post-liberation Bangladesh.
impact: His role helped translate the ideals of independence into the institutional language of rights, parliamentarism, and republican government.
highlight: Chair of the committee that drafted Bangladesh's 1972 Constitution.
seoTitle: Kamal Hossain: Architect of Bangladesh's 1972 Constitution
seoDescription: Learn about Kamal Hossain's role in drafting Bangladesh's 1972 Constitution and shaping its original parliamentary framework.
shortAnswer: Kamal Hossain chaired the committee that drafted Bangladesh's 1972 Constitution.
